text:
Maya (PM): Quick 20m — align on observability PRD launch criteria and scope tradeoffs for dashboards + trace retention. Customers pushing for retention tiers and per-route tracing. Agenda: must-have vs nice-to-have, acceptance criteria, rollout plan.

Omar (Eng): +1. Need target p95 latency impact for console queries. Retention tiering increases index size and could affect query times.

Lin (Design): UX constraints: avoid >2 clicks to get to trace timeline. Suggest compact timeline with expand-on-click.

Sara (SRE): Risk: retention tiering implies migration/backfill jobs. We need canary migration and throttles to avoid cluster pressure.

Ravi (CS): Customer ask: separate retention per-team inside an org — they say this is blocking for their go-live.

Maya (PM): Proposal: Launch M1 = org-level retention tiers (90d / 365d / preset custom up to 2y), basic dashboard filters, trace timeline UX. M2 = per-team retention, migration tooling, admin panels. Thoughts?

Omar (Eng): M1 OK if we limit custom retention UI to presets only. Defer backfills/migration to M2. Need an infra estimate.

Lin (Design): I'll mock wireframes for timeline + tier selector. Want to avoid modals that block the console. Need final microcopy by EOD Fri.

Sara (SRE): Draft acceptance criteria:
```
- Dashboard filter queries: median < 300ms on 30d indexed data
- Trace view: p95 < 1s for single-trace open
- Retention changes produce audit log entries and are reversible
- Migration/backfill can be paused/resumed and has safe defaults
```

Ava (Data): Track these metrics: daily index size, query cost per 1k requests, trace-fetch error rate, migration throughput. Baseline needed before canary.

Maya (PM): Edge cases to capture in PRD: orgs producing >100k traces/day, multi-region orgs, customers with strict e-discovery retention windows. Add runbook bits.

Omar (Eng): Also ensure streaming panels degrade gracefully (partial results + spinner) if node memory spikes.

Lin (Design): UX acceptance: retention selector should be inline, no blocking overlays; changing retention must show a confirmation with impacts summary.

Ravi (CS): Prioritization note: 3 enterprise customers in sales pipeline will postpone Dedicated adoption unless org-tiering exists. That ups the priority for M1 if we can scope it small.

Maya (PM): Decision for workshop: ship M1 with presets only; M2 to handle per-team and migrations. Action items:
- Lin: wireframes by Fri
- Omar: infra + infra-effort estimate by Tue (CPU/IO, storage delta)
- Sara: migration runbook + canary plan by Tue
- Ava: sample baseline metrics from prod by Mon
- Ravi: confirm customer SLAs and pilot interest

Lin (Design): noted and will send draft links.

Omar (Eng): I'll ping infra for quota and index sizing numbers.

Sara (SRE): Will draft runbook and include rollback commands + health checks.

Maya (PM): I'll update the PRD with the acceptance criteria and tag you all for RFC review. Please call out any missing edge cases. React with :white_check_mark: if you agree.
